name: realm-bench-ObstacleDet
description: realm-bench-ObstacleDet measures models' ability to detect and localize obstacles in visual inputs, aimed at robotics and autonomy applications. The benchmark focuses on accurate object detection under realistic conditions relevant to navigation and safety. It is used to compare detection algorithms and perception stacks for obstacle avoidance.
reputation: A task-focused dataset within the realm-bench collection with modest adoption among robotics and perception researchers.
